author: Krono I
title: PPO (1 Epoch, 1 Minibatch) vs PG Baseline
abstract: This is a performance debugging experiment to address timeouts in previous PPO runs (ID 19). By setting num_epochs=1 and num_minibatches=1, the computational cost per update is made equivalent to the baseline policy gradient. This allows the experiment to run to completion and provides a direct comparison between the PPO clipped surrogate objective and the standard policy gradient loss in a single-update setting, testing the core hypothesis under fair conditions.
